newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: FORECAST - Dutch company results week of Feb 3.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Dutch company results week of Feb 3.

text.p: Analysts' estimates of Dutch company results due this week include:
4/02 KLM Q3 NET PFT 12 PFT/54 LOSS 102
4/02 KLM Q3 OP PFT 35 PFT/25 LOSS 56
Profit figures are net before extraordinaries and in millions of guilders unless otherwise stated.
Securities houses surveyed include: Amstgeld, BZW, Generale Bank, ING, Kempen, Labouchere, MeesPierson, Paribas, Strating.
NOTE - Banks and brokers interested in contributing to Reuters surveys can contact the Amsterdam newsroom on +31-20-504-5000 or fax their forecasts to +31-20-504 5040.
For the week starting Feb 10 we are collecting annual result forecasts for; Unilever (11/02); KNP BT and PolyGram (12/02); Shell and Philips (13/02)
